text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The third year's Summer Training Camp has 
begun. Seeing the younger students getting 
carried away and about to cut loose, 
Sirius Symboli gives them a firm warning.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As the outlaw boss, Sirius Symboli gave 
everyone a glimpse of her true presence.
